title: A Drive operation already running when another adapter marks its popup token spent sends its remaining requests with that token: one more request each
evidence: Codex re-check R2 on lead A29 (branch claude/a29-drive-spent-token). Sequence: adapter B starts a record read; readDriveRecord (packages/health-core/src/drive-rest.ts) takes the token string once and reuses it across discovery, version and download; adapter A then gets a 401 and marks the shared popup token spent; B's discovery answers and B sends its version and download requests with the spent token. Each gets its own 401 from Drive, which spends nothing new, and B's next operation reads the spent copy and sends nothing (US-09 AC51). Effect: one more request per remaining step of an operation already in flight. No record data is touched. Candidate fix: re-check the token before each request inside the shared Drive helpers (pass a token getter, not a string, into drive-rest.ts). The hosted MCP's DriveAdapter shares drive-rest.ts, so the change must keep its one-call token use working. Owner: a lead after A29 merges, 2026-11-13
